page.overview:
Who is Tiana Noselle?

She is short and slight, with large brown eyes and a dimple in each cheek. Despite her ageless look she has an unfortunately youthful appearance due to her bone structure and large brown eyes. She usually wears dark gray skirts.

When she is displeased, her disgruntled expression deepened her dimple and makes her look sulky, which she doesn't realize.

Tiana is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability a the Talent, she should be able to Travel.
